text: I've now rung twice and been told someone would call back within the hour, and that was well over an hour ago, so I'm putting it in writing instead. I'm a foster carer and I've got a little boy with me, 21 months old, been with us a few months so I know him pretty well by now. He's had a temp since yesterday, 38.7 when I took it just now under the arm. What's bothering me isn't really the temperature. It's his crying. He's normally a proper loud bawler when he's cross, you'd hear him down the street. Tonight it's this thin, high, squeaky sort of cry, nothing like him, and it just goes on and on. I've cuddled him, walked him round, tried his bottle, put his telly programme on, and it doesn't stop or change. My partner said the same thing as soon as he heard it: that's not his cry. I also have to let his social worker know about anything like this so I need to know what I'm meant to do. Does he need seeing tonight or not? I'd appreciate an actual answer rather than another hold message.
